description: Returns the inflation / staking reward for a list of addresses for an epoch.

parameters.name: array
parameters.description: An array of addresses to query, as base-58 encoded strings

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: The configuration object with the following fields:

sub_parameters.name: commitment
sub_parameters.description: The level of commitment required for the query. The options include:

sub_parameters.name: epoch
sub_parameters.description: An epoch for which the reward occurs. If omitted, the previous epoch will be used

sub_parameters.name: minContextSlot
sub_parameters.description: The minimum slot that the request can be evaluated at

result.description: The result will be JSON object with the following fields:

result.epoch.description: The epoch during which the reward was received

result.effectiveSlot.description: The slot at which the rewards become active

result.postBalance.description: The account balance after the transaction in lamports

result.commission.description: The commission rate of the vote account at the time the reward was credited
